title: Mochizuki Honami — Swimming Lessons in the Sea〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It feels like it's been so long since we last came to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. We were only at the Seaside School for a few days, but I get what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It was so much fun too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It really was. It came and went so quickly too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was a nice break from our usual routine, but I'm sure we're all ready to get back to it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're all here!
Welcome back.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks. It's nice to be back.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since you're all here, does this mean you're going back to practicing like normal?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. But before we start...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We brought back some gifts for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You did?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. You've done so much for us until now, so we wanted to give back by bringing back some stuff from our trip.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, are these fish-shaped oshikura-manju?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, they're called Fish-kura because of that. The place we stayed at is apparently famous for them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's just like you to choose these, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...? I know they look cute, but they're supposed to be pretty good...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, didn't you say that you thought they were super cute when we found them...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. She sure did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
Anyway, Saki, you're next.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I brought..
Sea candy!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sea candy?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! When you put one in your mouth, it turns into a burst of sea aromas!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it also says that they're all lychee-flavored.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I guess it's not 100% ocean-themed.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they're supposed to give you the sensation of being by the beach or the ocean, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure they will since they're named as such.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think they really like your gift, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Mind if I go next?
I brought a tray of seashells...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, they're so big.
This one even looks like a rainbow on the inside!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That one...? Oh, I think it's the scallop shell that I found on the beach.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I heard that polishing it a certain way makes it shine like that, so I tried it after I got home.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You spent quite a bit of time on it too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They were all sun-bleached white, but I'm glad I was at least able to get its color back on the inside.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They might not be big or deep enough to use as tableware, but I'm sure they'll make for some nice decorations.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It might be just the right size for the candy Saki brought us or guitar picks. Either way, I promise to cherish it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And finally, my gift to you is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, photo frames.
They've been decorated with sea glass too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, these colors are so beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad you like them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This is amazing...!
Each piece is a different size, but you got them to fit together so well!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that's Honami the artisan for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're both exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But where did you get these? I don't think I saw any sea glass on the beach.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My group tried looking too, but we couldn't find any.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu was the one who showed us a nice spot where we could find some.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. We found a bunch, huh?
Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here! We made photo frames for you too, Ichika, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You did...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You could've said something sooner... We would've brought something for you too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But that would defeat the whole purpose of this surprise, wouldn't it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We even made some frames for ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! So we all have a matching set!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I even brought Seaside School pics, so let's find some good ones and put these to use right away!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You brought pictures?
Someone came prepared...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They really did...
Thank you very much, Honami, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Mind if I look too?
I'm sure we'll still have plenty of time to practice afterward.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to as well. Would that be alright with you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course!
